text: # Billing & Subscription Policy ## Plan Pricing The Starter plan is $29/month, billed monthly to the card on file. The Team plan is $79/month. Annual billing is available on either plan at a 15% discount versus paying monthly. ## Overcharges and Billing Errors If a customer is charged more than their plan's listed price — for example, a Starter customer billed $58 instead of $29 — this is treated as a billing error, not a plan upgrade, unless the customer explicitly opted into an add-on or a second seat. Support should verify the customer's current plan tier in the billing system, confirm no add-ons are active, and if the charge doesn't match the plan price, refund the difference to the original payment method within 3-5 business days. No manager approval is required for refunds under $100. ## Refund Timing Refunds are issued to the original payment method. Card refunds typically post within 3-5 business days; bank transfer refunds can take up to 10 business days. Support should tell the customer the expected timing when confirming a refund. ## Duplicate Charges A duplicate charge (the same amount billed twice in one cycle) is refunded in full automatically once confirmed in the billing system, no partial-refund calculation needed.
